anomaly_signals.detail: 615 errors out of 1000 spans (61.5% error rate) — highest absolute error count in the stack; likely cascading from downstream failures.
210 genai_tool_failures recorded system-wide, with 201 error spans on tool-executor (44.5% error rate across 452 spans) — primary driver of agent_failure scenario.
234 errors out of 1000 spans (23.4% error rate), compounded by 119 errors on postgres-auth (11.9%) — auth layer under significant stress.
177 errors out of 452 spans (39.2% error rate) — agents failing at high frequency, consistent with tool_failure cascade.
130 errors out of 431 spans (30.2% error rate), with 86 additional errors on postgres-payments (20.0%) — payment flows materially impacted.
p99 latency of 25,023 ms system-wide; llm-gemini has 81 error spans out of 860 (9.4%) contributing to elevated tail latency.
30 genai token truncation events detected — prompts or responses being cut short, potentially degrading agent reasoning quality.
41 errors out of 226 spans (18.1% error rate) — orchestration layer partially degraded, limiting agent workflow completion.
75 errors out of 452 spans (16.6% error rate) — memory retrieval failures likely degrading agent context continuity.

recommended_action: Immediately investigate tool-executor for the root cause of 210 tool failures (44.5% span error rate) — this is the primary driver of the agent_failure scenario and is cascading errors up through agent-service, workflow-orchestrator, and api-gateway. Redeploy or isolate degraded tool-executor instances, review tool plugin configurations, and check for dependency timeouts causing the 25s p99 latency. Separately, audit auth-service → postgres-auth connectivity and payments-service → postgres-payments for independent DB-layer issues. Address LLM token truncations by reviewing prompt size limits on llm-gemini.
summary: A severe agent_failure scenario is active, with a system-wide error rate of 23.3% and p99 latency of 25 seconds. The fault is primarily rooted in tool-executor (44.5% error rate, 210 tool failures), cascading through agent-service and workflow-orchestrator up to the api-gateway, while auth, payments, and LLM layers show significant independent degradation.
